title: API Testing Tools: What to Know

scenes.say: Which API testing tool should you use, and why does it matter in interviews?

scenes.label: Postman
scenes.sub: Great for manual and automated REST API tests.
scenes.say: Postman is a favorite for manual and automated testing of REST APIs. It's user-friendly and powerful.
For automation, Java teams often use REST Assured, while Python fans reach for pytest with requests.
These tools help you automate checks, plug into CI pipelines, and show interviewers you know industry standards.

scenes.question: Should you always use Postman?
scenes.wrong: Yes, it's the best for everything.
scenes.right: No, pick tools based on tech stack and CI needs.
scenes.say: Don't just default to Postman. Choose your tool based on the team's tech stack and how it fits into CI workflows.
